title: LedgerEntryPosted
description: Published by ledger-service on the `finpay.ledger` topic after a double-entry posting is committed. The ledger is the source of truth for money movement; this event is the immutable posting notification. Partitioned by accountId.

eventId.description: Globally unique event identifier. Consumers MUST deduplicate on this field (outbox redelivery / at-least-once semantics).

eventType.description: Fixed event type; matches the schema name and the stream-filterable discriminator.

occurredAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the event occurred.

version.description: Major schema version of this event. Additive changes stay at the same major; breaking changes require a new vN/ schema.

partitionKey.description: Kafka partition key; equals the business key accountId for ordering per account.

postingId.description: Ledger posting identifier; immutable once committed.

accountId.description: Ledger account the entry is posted against.

debit.description: Debit leg amount as a decimal string (zero if credit-only posting).

credit.description: Credit leg amount as a decimal string (zero if debit-only posting).

amount.description: Posting amount as a decimal string (no floating point).

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code of the posting.

ts.description: Business timestamp when the posting was committed.
